# مبتعث للدراسات والاستشارات الاكاديمية (Mobt3ath)

> > Academic research and consulting platform serving Saudi universities with Scopus-indexed publishing, thesis writing, and graduate studies support services.

Mobt3ath provides comprehensive academic services for researchers and graduate students across Saudi Arabia, particularly serving institutions like Shaqra University and supporting scholars throughout the Kingdom with scientific publishing, statistical analysis, translation, and research consultation.

## Key Topics

- Scopus Indexing
- Thesis Writing & Assistance
- Saudi Universities (جامعة شقراء)
- Academic Consulting
- Scientific Journal Publishing
- Research References
- Graduate Studies Support
- Statistical Analysis
- Academic Translation
- Ministry of Education (وزارة التعليم)
- Scholarly Publishing
- Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Research
- Academic Research Services
- Scientific Research Methodology
- Shaqra University Network

## Core Academic Services

- [مبتعث للدراسات والاستشارات الاكاديمية](https://mobt3ath.com/det.php): Academic studies & consulting services for Saudi universities & Scopus
- [Graduate Studies Support](https://mobt3ath.com/dets.php): Graduate studies support: thesis, translation & statistical analysis

## Search & Discovery

- [Academic Search](https://mobt3ath.com/serche.php): Search results for academic journals, research & thesis writing services
